observed_context: Use source-bound Chain datasets and the same retained F4 boosters. Unknown actor/fives are unsupported for actor-specific nodes. parity: Compare _context, _five/_actor and assignment features on the identical recorded start-of-segment history. Separately measure the actual runtime phase that adds elapsed shot_time before actor selection. Report both and all unsupported columns; no silent correction.
minutes_oracle: Use exactly the frozen player-rate posterior with the same seed/stat/player order and realised full-game on-court minutes replacing shared forecast minutes. Fixing real minutes does not make this a live forecast, and this simple count law is not a play-by-play oracle.
opportunity_oracle: Fix realised full-game minutes plus each player's 2PA, 3PA and FTA. Draw Beta then Binomial for each attempt channel; derive PTS=2*2PM+3*3PM+FTM exactly. Only PTS/3PM are supported. Never add this gain to minutes-oracle gain.

new_zone_capture: The original incumbent worlds have no zone counts. Replay events using one-second schedules reconstructed solely from their STORED SIMULATED phase-0 fives. Report schedule discretisation error and the resulting full-game scores separately from the primary retained benchmark. All generated scoring/minutes and zone/box identities must pass. No production change.
opponent_lineup_sensitivity: Fixed observed offence, actor, clock, history and random stream. Replace defending five with the prior strongest/weakest eligible five from the same opponent roster; separately replace opponent feature profiles with those from a prior-date panel opponent, holding offence fixed. Report probability/expected-FG-point sensitivity only; recorded-game regression establishes predictive association.
evidence_boundary: Raw outcome readers are predicate-bound to the exact 200 IDs or training dates <=2025-12-31. Reuse original receipt hashes. First20 wiring before full200, no tuning, no reserved/protected outcomes. Use at most 10 heavy threads with all inner caps=1.
